text:
Predicates:
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
Wrote(y, x) ::: y wrote x.
FamilyHistory(x) ::: x is Family History.
Created(y, x) ::: y created x.
Year(x, y) ::: x was written in year y.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
DaniShapiro(x) ::: x is Dani Shapiro.
City(y) ::: y is a city.
Boston(y) ::: y is Boston.
Premises:
BG :: [Background information]
BornIn(DaniShapiro, y) → American(DaniShapiro) ::: If Dani Shapiro was born in y, then Dani Shapiro is American.
Book(FamilyHistory) ∧ Wrote(DaniShapiro, FamilyHistory) ∧ Novel(FamilyHistory) ∧ Year(FamilyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro, is a novel, and was written in 2003.
Created(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
Boston(y) ∧ American(y) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
BornIn(DaniShapiro, y) ∧ Boston(y) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
